digest.component_or_area: Documentation and comment quality audit across repository
propositions: Repository-wide documentation and comments violate operator standards for prose structure, diction, and formal voice including em dashes, semicolons, contractions, filler terms, and non-atomic claims.

External documentation and shipped help contain incomplete, incorrect, or duplicated guidance on certificate operations, import idempotency, CLI option coverage, relation attributes, and configuration.
Internal documentation lacks canonical ownership assignments, current-state accuracy, and lifecycle clarity for ADRs, architecture, event schemas, concurrency models, and migration procedures.
Developer comments and embedded prose lack necessary contextual citations, contain historical narration instead of implementation context, and need inventory-driven remediation by shard.
Documentation navigation, index validation, and ownership tracking infrastructure require establishment to prevent future drift and enable maintenance.

Foundation enforcement through policy documentation, prose validation tooling, and comment hygiene expansion must precede and govern all file-level corrections to ensure conformance and sustainability.
